semiconductor_relevance: High - Daicel Corporation provides a range of functional materials essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Daicel Corporation is a chemical manufacturer specializing in functional materials for semiconductor production, including photoresist polymers, high-boiling solvents, and PFAS-free release films. Their products are designed to enhance device performance and yield in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
capabilities: Photoresist polymers for ArF and EUV lithography
